title: Workflow Board Builder Service State
description: Generates a complete HKP board JSON from a natural language description using an AI model. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/workflow-board-builder)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

description.description: Natural language description of the desired board

inputBoardSource.description: Optional existing board JSON to refine or extend

generatedBoardSource.description: The generated board JSON (editable in the UI)
